$ Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about XFree tools

Are XFree tools really free to use?

Yes, 100% free with no hidden costs. No premium tiers, no usage limits, no ads. We believe everyone deserves access to quality developer tools regardless of budget.

Is my data safe when using XFree tools?

Absolutely. All processing happens in your browser using JavaScript APIs. Your data is never sent to our servers. For tools like our Hash Generator, we use the Web Crypto API for cryptographically secure operations.

Do I need to create an account to use XFree?

No account required. Simply visit XFree.in and start using any tool immediately. No signup, no email verification, no API keys needed.

How do I report a bug or request a new tool?

Visit our contact page or use the feedback form on any tool page. We actively develop new tools based on user requests and fix bugs quickly.

Can I use XFree tools in my commercial projects?

Yes. XFree tools are free for personal and commercial use. We simply ask that you don't build a competing service using our infrastructure.

Why do some tools show AI-powered features?

Some advanced tools use AI APIs to provide enhanced functionality. These are clearly marked, and you can choose to use the non-AI version if you prefer pure client-side processing.
